literal_meaning: কোনো এক মত বা উপায়ে (by some means or opinion)
figurative_meaning_en: with great difficulty or by some means
similar_in_english: by the skin of one's teeth
example_sentences_in_bangla: অল্প আয়ে কোনমতে সংসার চালানো যায় না।
example_sentences_in_english: It's hard to run a household somehow on a small income.
He barely passed the exam with great difficulty.
note: This idiom reflects the everyday struggles in Bengali socio-economic contexts.
